parts.name: Mojave Sphinx Vehicle
parts.description: Complete N2O/E85 liquid bipropellant rocket, 4 in airframe. HCR-5100 flight vehicle.

parts.name: Propellant Tank Assembly
parts.description: Integral fuel/oxidizer tank: drilled 4 in tube, piston, fuel and oxidizer bulkhead subassemblies, retaining rings.

parts.name: Fluid System
parts.description: Feedlines, fill plumbing, quick disconnect, and fittings between tank outlets and the thrust chamber.

parts.name: Valve Actuation Group
parts.description: Fuel and oxidizer servo-actuated ball valves with mounts and hardware.

parts.name: Thrust Chamber Assembly
parts.description: Injector, combustion chamber, nozzle with spring-retained copper throat insert, flange plates and tie rods.

parts.name: Igniter Cartridge
parts.description: Pyrotechnic igniter cartridge built from brass pipe fittings.

parts.name: Airframe Group
parts.description: Nose cone, airframe tubes, fin brackets, fins, rail buttons, templates.

parts.name: Recovery System
parts.description: Main and drogue parachutes, shock cord, protectors, anchors.

parts.name: Avionics Bay Assembly
parts.description: Dual Eggtimer Quark deployment controllers on a plywood sled in a printed coupler with switch band.

parts.name: Servo-Actuated Ball Valve Assembly
parts.description: SABV-04FF: DS3225 servo on printed mount driving a 1/4 NPT brass ball valve via printed handle connector. Built by the Servo-Actuated Ball Valve Assembly procedure; two per vehicle, one for the GSE fill valve.

parts.name: Mojave Sphinx GSE
parts.description: Remotely-controlled fluid handling and firing system in a 21 in steel toolbox: N2O fill/dump, ignition power, vehicle valve command.

parts.name: GSE Control System
parts.description: RC transmitter/receiver, relay, regulator, switches, battery, panel I/O.

parts.name: GSE Fill System
parts.description: N2O supply plumbing: supply bottle, fill valve (SABV), gauge, fill line, quick disconnect.

parts.name: GSE Enclosure
parts.description: 21 in steel toolbox with panel holes, eye bolts and battery restraints.

parts.name: GSE Integration Hardware
parts.description: Cable stock, purge plumbing, brackets, and hardware from the GSE OP gather lists (not in the 6.2 BOM subtotal).
